description: This file implements a UDP server for receiving packets, managing sessions per client address, validating packets with a pseudo-random number generator, and handling incoming data asynchronously using threading and select.

classes.name: TEUDPReceiveSession
classes.description: Manages individual UDP client sessions, tracking received and dropped packets, and validating packet data.

classes.name: TEUDPReceive
classes.description: Implements a UDP server that listens for incoming packets, manages sessions, and sends responses based on session activity.

methods.name: TEUDPReceiveSession.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a session with an address, timeout, and packet counters.

methods.name: TEUDPReceiveSession.on_packet_received
methods.description: Processes incoming packet data, updating counters based on validation.

methods.name: TEUDPReceiveSession.update
methods.description: Checks if the session has timed out and returns packet statistics if so.

methods.name: TEUDPReceiveSession._validate_packet_
methods.description: Validates packet data using a pseudo-random number generator sequence.

methods.name: TEUDPReceive.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the UDP server, thread, and session list.

methods.name: _target_
methods.description: Main server loop that listens for incoming UDP packets, manages sessions, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: _get_session_by_address_
methods.description: Retrieves an existing session by address or creates a new one.

methods.name: _update_sessions_
methods.description: Updates all sessions, sends responses for timed-out sessions, and removes expired sessions.
